name: Commercial Wreaths
headline: 4-foot wreaths built for building fronts.
summary: Commercial-grade wreaths from 3 to 8 feet, pre-lit and weather-rated, sized so they still read from across a parking lot.
intro: A residential wreath disappears on a commercial facade. Ours are built on welded steel frames with UV-stable PVC tips, pre-lit with commercial LED, and finished with weatherproof velvet bows. The 4-foot wreath is the workhorse — big enough to anchor a main entrance, small enough to hang on a standard bracket.

Bracket, cable or pole-mount hardware included

name: Mega Trees
headline: 14-foot mega trees that hold a courtyard.
summary: Freestanding commercial Christmas trees from 8 to 30 feet, engineered for wind, assembled on site and taken down in January.
intro: A mega tree is the centrepiece — it decides whether a plaza reads as decorated or as an afterthought. Ours ship as a sectional steel frame with pre-strung commercial LED, guy-wire or ballast anchoring rated for exposed sites, and a topper. The 14-foot is the most-specified size for courtyards, entrances and small squares.

Ballast plate or guy-wire, engineered for exposed sites
Breaks down flat; off-season storage available

name: Large Displays
headline: 3D LED displays people stop and photograph.
summary: Freestanding 2D and 3D LED figures, walk-through photo-ops and hanging spheres — the pieces that turn lighting into a destination.
intro: Rooflines make a property look decorated. Displays make people drive to it. These are commercial-grade steel-and-LED figures built to stand outdoors all season, sized from tabletop motifs up to walk-through arches, and shipped with the stakes, ballast and power distribution to install them properly.

name: Custom Displays
headline: Built to your brand, not from a catalogue.
summary: Custom-fabricated LED displays — logos, wordmarks, archways and one-off centrepieces designed for a specific property.
intro: When the catalogue does not have it, we build it. Custom work starts with the property and the brand: we scale a concept to the sightlines, draw it, quote it, fabricate it, and install it. Common briefs are illuminated logos and wordmarks, entrance archways, themed photo-ops for a downtown BIA, and centrepieces sized to a specific atrium.
specs: Book by June for the same season
